prompt: A clock face is designed as a regular $12$-sided polygon. What is the measure of each exterior angle, in degrees?
hint: The exterior angles of ANY convex polygon always add to $360^\circ$.

hints.text: The exterior angles of ANY convex polygon always add to $360^\circ$.
Regular means all $12$ exterior angles are equal, so divide $360$ by $12$.

explanation: Walking once around any convex polygon turns you through a full $360^\circ$.
In a regular $12$-gon those turns are all equal: $360 \div 12$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Walk the perimeter
steps: Imagine walking along each edge and turning the same amount at every corner.
After $12$ corners you are facing your original direction again, so the $12$ turns total $360^\circ$ — each turn is $30^\circ$.
